fact: Cabo Verde's response states it has no centralised beneficial-owner register, one is proposed under the registry and notary directorate, and the commercial registry system (SIRC) integrates with the firm-name register and the tax authority's NIF.
title: Cabo Verde response to the UNCAC Working Group questionnaire on beneficial ownership transparency
publisher: UNODC, UNCAC Working Group on Prevention (response by GPM/GCI, Cabo Verde)
